verdict.rationale: Phaser's installation docs describe an official CLI tool that offers an interactive selection of official project templates and demo games, then downloads and configures the chosen package. Its documented scope is limited to project scaffolding, and it is described as question-driven and interactive, so its fit for non-interactive, agent-driven use is unproven. missing for 10: documented command name and flags, non-interactive/scriptable mode, CLI capabilities beyond scaffolding (build, run, asset or game management), AI-oriented CLI features, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: This CLI tool presents an interactive selection of official project templates and demo games. Issue the command, answer some questions and the app will download and configure the right package for you.
